title: Send a greeting
summary: Fiber: Send a greeting. Change the greeting.
introduction: A Fiber handler returns an error value. SendString writes the response text. Open GET /hello.

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Send a greeting
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Get("/hello", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString("Hello, Asha!") })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: The matching handler receives a Fiber v2 context. Returning SendString returns any writing error too.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Return the error from response-writing methods.
